# Pull Request Template — Hotfix

## ⚠️ URGENT: Production Hotfix

## Issue Description
Critical production issue requiring immediate fix.

## Impact
- **Severity**: Critical/High/Medium
- **Affected Users**: All/Specific segment
- **Business Impact**: Description

## Root Cause
What caused the issue?

## Fix Applied
What was changed to fix the issue?

## Testing
- [ ] Reproduced original issue
- [ ] Verified fix resolves issue
- [ ] No regression in related features

## Deployment Notes
Special deployment instructions or considerations.

- [ ] Update documentation
